title: 第十章 病症
content_zh:
几秒后，冉青墨手里拎着一只白色巨虎从天而降重重的砸在了地面之上。
白虎长达两丈的巨大身躯在冉青墨手里就如同一只大号的猫咪，被按着后脖颈按在地上动弹不得。
冉青墨松开手，指了指地上趴着的白虎，朝着许元走来，轻声问道：
“它，可以吗？”
许元没说话。
他看到冉青墨松开手后，这只大老虎就悄悄的抬起了头，一双竖瞳阴森森的死死盯着冉青墨后背。
下一刻，
许元便看到这老虎试图用自己的生命在冉青墨面前诠释了什么叫无自由，毋宁死。
白色巨虎猛地发力扑向女子纤弱的倩影，直接被冉青墨反手一剑鞘把敲在脑壳上。
那一瞬间，许元隐隐看到了飞在半空中白色巨虎那被打得快要升天的迷离眼神。
白虎庞大的身躯化作残影倒飞而出，重重的撞在一旁一颗数十米外一颗百米参天巨树的树根处。
冉青墨走向许元的脚步顿住，回头看了那边老虎一眼，有些失望低声喃喃：
“好像还不可以....”
对着许元低声说了一句 “稍等一下”，提着剑便朝着烟尘掀起处走去。
沉寂片刻，那团腾起的烟尘中猛地窜出了一道白色残影，不过没有再扑向冉青墨，连滚带爬直接想往远处森林的深处逃去。
人类女人，好恐怖，得逃。
冉青墨脚下一踏，身影消失原地。
“砰！”
一声闷响划破寂静的森林，惊起一片飞鸟。
冉青墨稳稳落地，看了看脑壳被打进土里一动不动的大老虎，默默的伸手抓住它的脑袋上的皮毛，拖着便缓步朝着许元走来。

许元看着眼前这一幕，眼角抽了抽。
站定，冉青墨对着许元点点头：
“现在应该可以了，你上去试一下。”
许元张了张嘴，瞥了一眼地上趴着不动的大白虎。
白虎半眯着，明显是在装死，眼神带着些许警告的盯着许元。
妖兽皆有灵智，只是或高或低，到了此刻大白虎已经明白这个恐怖的人类女人是想把它当做坐骑送给眼前这个人类男人。
许元略微沉默，出于对冉青墨实力信任，还是一步步朝着趴在地面的老虎走去。
刚一走进，
白虎半眯着的眼睛睁开盯着许元，脑袋微微抬起，喉头发出一声警告式的低吼：..
“吼....”
士可杀，不可辱。
“砰！”
站在旁边的女子听到声音直接便是一剑鞘。
“嗷呜....”白虎从心的把脑袋低了下去。
许元见状便抓着白虎的皮毛爬上了它的后背。
白虎皮毛柔顺，软乎乎的，摸上去很舒服，有一种前世撸猫的感觉。
许元试着在白虎的脑袋上摸了两把，结果摸到了几个肿起大包。
“吼.....”白虎低吼。
“砰！”大包又多了一个。
“呜....”白虎老实的把脑袋趴了下去。

冉青墨缓缓收回剑鞘，轻声道：
“走吧。”
说着，她侧眸瞥了白虎一眼。
冉青墨的一个眼神，许元感觉身下的大白虎一阵摇晃，没急着起身，而是先用脑袋蹭了蹭冉青墨黑衣的裙角。
许元见到这一幕有些想笑，唇角刚刚上扬，一股胸闷夹杂着轻微瘙痒感忽然在心间蔓延开来。
“.......”
笑容止住，许元皱了皱眉。
这两天来这种瘙痒感觉他已经体验过数次。
大致是原身 “嗑药”带来成瘾性，只要撑过半刻钟，这种感觉自然而然就会褪去。
思维刚刚闪过，许元准备开口延迟一下前进的时间，可话尚未出口，胸口内部的这股瘙痒感便突然如同病变了一般疯狂扩散，在几秒转化为了一种令人发狂的 “瘾头”。
一股强烈的窒息感顺江让许元眼前一黑。
许元下意识攥紧了身下白虎柔顺的皮毛稳住身形，但一阵阵眩晕不断涌上心头，原本笔直的腰杆一点点的躬了下去，用力攥着皮毛的手也缓缓无力的松开，身形不受控制的朝着一旁侧翻倒下。
冉青墨第一时间察觉了许元的异样，一个闪身扶住了即将倒地的许元，黛眉微颦：
“你..怎么了？”
许元眼前一阵发黑，张了张想说话，一抹腥甜的感觉猛地从喉头间涌出。
“哇啊.....”
一大口鲜血吐在褐色的地面之上，难受的感觉让许元下意识推开了一旁扶着他的冉青墨，让自己半跪在了地上。
意识一阵模糊，许元疼痛与令人窒息的瘾头让他将手指深深嵌入进了土壤之中。
他忽然意识到这种症状不可能是嗑药嗑出来的。
这身体，有问题。

许元脑海中飞速回忆着与原身许长天相关的信息，可即便翻来覆去的思索，也依旧没有丝毫的头绪。
公式书、游戏剧情、相关小说中都没有记载过原身会有这种症状，更别提找出原因。
是...世界的自动补全？
许元脑海中一个念头闪过。
即便《沧源》有着千万字级别的本文，但对于一整个世界二人却依旧还是太小，那些文字未能描述的留白部分自然就会被自动补全完善。
可为什么世界补全会让这原身有这种症状？！
许元试图在脑海中找出线索，但意识已然开始昏沉，眼皮的沉重让他痛苦的闭上了眼睛......
意识迷糊间，许元隐隐感觉一股冰凉的触感从小腹处传入。
很熟悉的冰凉感。
这是...冉青墨在用炁？
与上次失温时的一触及退不同，这一次许元能够清晰的感知到的冉青墨带来的这抹冰凉快速的从手腕蔓延到了全身。
一片漆黑中，
胸口那抹令人窒息的疼痛被一阵又一阵绵延不绝的冰寒冲刷，最终一点点的瓦解，直至消失隐匿..........
再次醒来，已然斗转星移，旭日不复。
许元从指缝间依稀可见那树冠外的一轮皓月伴和漫天的星辰。
许元愣愣的盯着夜空看了很久，昏迷前的记忆如潮水般涌上心头。
眉头微皱，许元立刻坐起身，心有余悸的摸了摸自己胸口。
先前那抹盘踞在胸口的痛苦源头已然消失不见。
“醒了？”
女子清淡的声音吸引了许元的注意，转眸望去，许元立刻看到了那位以熟悉的姿势坐在树旁闭目养神的黑衣女子。

记起昏迷时体内的冰凉感，许元略微点头，出声询问道：
“嗯，冉先生，你不是说...普通人不能用炁治疗么？”
冉青墨缓缓睁开了眸子，静静注视了许元很久，声音在夜晚中格外清晰：
“普通人确实不能，但你昏迷时体内有炁。
“而且，有很多。”
content_en:
A few seconds later, Ran Qingmo dropped from the sky with a giant white tiger in his hand and hit the ground heavily.
The white tiger's two-foot-long body was like a large cat in Ran Qingmo's hands, being pinned to the ground by the back of his neck and unable to move.
Ran Qingmo let go of his hand, pointed at the white tiger lying on the ground, walked towards Xu Yuan, and asked softly:
"Is it okay?"
Xu Yuan said nothing.
He saw that after Ran Qingmo let go of his hand, the big tiger quietly raised its head, staring at Ran Qingmo's back with a pair of erect eyes.
The next moment,
Xu Yuan saw the tiger trying to use his own life to explain in front of Ran Qingmo what it means to have no freedom or rather die.
The giant white tiger suddenly pounced on the woman's delicate figure, but was directly hit on the head by Ran Qingmo's backhand with the sheath of his sword.
At that moment, Xu Yuan faintly saw the confused look of the giant white tiger flying in the air, which was about to rise to the sky after being beaten.
The huge body of the white tiger turned into an afterimage and flew out upside down, hitting the roots of a giant tree dozens of meters away and a hundred meters tall.
Ran Qingmo paused as he walked towards Xu Yuan, looked back at the tiger over there, and murmured in a low voice with some disappointment:
"It seems it's not possible yet..."
He whispered to Xu Yuan, "Wait a moment," and walked towards the smoke and dust with his sword in hand.
After a moment of silence, a white afterimage suddenly emerged from the rising smoke, but it did not pounce on Ran Qingmo again, and rolled and crawled directly to escape into the depths of the distant forest.
Human women are so scary, they have to run away.
Ran Qingmo stepped on the ground and disappeared.
"Bang!"
A muffled sound broke through the silent forest, startling a flock of birds.
Ran Qingmo landed firmly, looked at the big tiger whose head was beaten into the ground and was motionless, silently stretched out his hand to grab the fur on its head, and dragged it slowly towards Xu Yuan.
Xu Yuan's eyes twitched as he looked at the scene in front of him.
Standing still, Ran Qingmo nodded to Xu Yuan:
"It should be fine now, go up and try it."
Xu Yuan opened his mouth and glanced at the big white tiger lying motionless on the ground.
Bai Hu half-squinted, obviously pretending to be dead, and stared at Xu Yuan with a hint of warning.
Monsters and beasts all have intelligence, but it may be higher or lower. At this moment, the big white tiger has understood that this terrifying human woman wants to give it to the human man in front of her as a mount.
Xu Yuan was slightly silent, but out of trust in Ran Qingmo's strength, he walked step by step towards the tiger lying on the ground.
As soon as I walked in,
Bai Hu opened his half-closed eyes and stared at Xu Yuan, raised his head slightly, and let out a warning growl from his throat:...
"Roar..."
Scholars can be killed but not humiliated.
"Bang!"
The woman standing nearby heard the sound and heard a scabbard.
"Ouch..." Bai Hu lowered his head sincerely.
When Xu Yuan saw this, he grabbed the white tiger's fur and climbed onto its back.
The white tiger's fur is soft and soft, and feels very comfortable to the touch. It feels like petting a cat in a previous life.
Xu Yuan tried to touch Bai Hu's head twice, but found several large swellings.
"Roar..." Bai Hu growled.
"Bang!" There was another one in the big bag.
"Ugh..." Bai Hu lay his head down honestly.
Ran Qingmo slowly retracted the scabbard and said softly:
"Let's go."
As she said that, she glanced sideways at Bai Hu.
With Ran Qingmo's look, Xu Yuan felt the big white tiger underneath him shake. Instead of getting up in a hurry, he first rubbed his head against the hem of Ran Qingmo's black dress.
Xu Yuan wanted to laugh when he saw this scene. Just as the corners of his lips rose, a feeling of chest tightness mixed with a slight itching suddenly spread in his heart.
"...."
The smile stopped and Xu Yuan frowned.
He had experienced this itching sensation several times in the past two days.
It's probably because of the addiction caused by "taking drugs". As long as you last for half a quarter of an hour, this feeling will become natural.will fade away.
As soon as his thoughts flashed through his mind, Xu Yuan was about to speak and delay his progress, but before he could say anything, the itching feeling inside his chest suddenly spread like a disease and turned into a maddening "addiction" in a few seconds.
A strong sense of suffocation flowed down the river, making Xu Yuan's eyes darken.
Xu Yuan subconsciously tightened his grip on the soft fur of the white tiger under him to stabilize his body, but waves of dizziness kept coming to his heart. His originally straight waist bowed a little bit, and the hand that was holding the fur slowly and feebly loosened, and his body rolled to the side uncontrollably.
Ran Qingmo noticed Xu Yuan's strangeness immediately, and quickly stepped forward to support Xu Yuan who was about to fall to the ground. His eyebrows furrowed slightly:
"What's wrong with you?"
Xu Yuan's eyes went dark for a while, and he opened his mouth to speak, but a fishy-sweet feeling suddenly surged out of his throat.
"Wow..."
A large mouthful of blood spat out on the brown ground. The uncomfortable feeling made Xu Yuan subconsciously push away Ran Qingmo, who was supporting him, and let himself kneel on the ground.
His consciousness blurred for a while, and Xu Yuan's pain and suffocating addiction caused him to embed his fingers deeply into the soil.
He suddenly realized that these symptoms could not be caused by taking drugs.
There is something wrong with this body.
Xu Yuan's mind was rapidly recalling information related to his original body, Xu Changtian, but even after thinking over and over again, he still had no clue.
There is no record in the formula book, game plot, or related novels that the original body will have such symptoms, let alone find out the cause.
Is it... the world's autocomplete?
An idea flashed in Xu Yuan's mind.
Even though "Cangyuan" has a text of tens of millions of words, it is still too small for a whole world of two people. The blank parts that cannot be described by words will naturally be automatically completed and completed.
But why does World Completion cause this original body to have such symptoms? !
Xu Yuan tried to find clues in his mind, but his consciousness had already begun to faint, and the heavy eyelids made him close his eyes in pain...
In a daze of consciousness, Xu Yuan felt a cold touch coming from his lower abdomen.
A very familiar cold feeling.
Is this... Ran Qingmo using Qi?
Different from the last time he experienced hypothermia, this time Xu Yuan could clearly feel the coldness brought by Ran Qingmo quickly spreading from his wrists to his whole body.
In total darkness,
The suffocating pain in the chest was washed away by waves of endless coldness, and finally disintegrated bit by bit until it disappeared and disappeared...
When I woke up again, the stars had changed and the sun was gone.
Xu Yuan could vaguely see the bright moon outside the tree canopy and the stars in the sky through his fingers.
Xu Yuan stared blankly at the night sky for a long time, and the memories before coma flooded into his mind.
Frowning slightly, Xu Yuan immediately sat up and touched his chest with lingering fear.
The source of pain that was previously entrenched in his chest has disappeared.
"Are you awake?"
The woman's calm voice attracted Xu Yuan's attention. Turning his eyes, Xu Yuan immediately saw the woman in black sitting in a familiar posture next to the tree with her eyes closed and concentrating.
Remembering the cold feeling in his body when he was unconscious, Xu Yuan nodded slightly and asked aloud:
"Well, Mr. Ran, didn't you say that... ordinary people can't use Qi for treatment?"
Ran Qingmo slowly opened his eyes and stared at Xu Yuan quietly for a long time. His voice was particularly clear in the night:
"It's true that ordinary people can't, but you have Qi in your body when you're in a coma.
“And, there are a lot of them. "
